tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༁ྃ:zab bdun dbang dang dngos grub kyi zab pa rta mgrin dbang chen gyi gtor zlog gi rim pa gnam lcags thog mda' zhes bya ba bzhugs so:
༁ྃ:zab bdun dbang dang dngos grub kyi zab pa rta mgrin dbang chen gyi gtor zlog gi rim pa gnam lcags thog mda' zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: zab bdun dbang dang dngos grub kyi zab pa rta mgrin dbang chen gyi gtor zlog gi rim pa gnam lcags thog mda' zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

bla ma dpal chen he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal chen pad+ma dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa bsnyen sgrub la drod rtags thon pa'i sngags pas dbang chen drag po'i gtor ma'i las brtsam pa la gsum/ dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gro bca' gzhi gzhan du shes par bya/ dngos gzhi sgrub pa'i tshul ni las byang gzhung bsrang zhing bka' srung gsol mchod dang skong ba grub nas/ mdun du tri las gnod byed thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo ma traṃ ru tra mgo lho nub rkang pa byang shar du gnas pa/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum gyi rgyu dug gsum dug lnga thams cad ma traṃ la thim pas bsgral ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan par gyur/ ma traṃ ru tra mā ra ya phaṭa: ces brjod pas ma traṃ des las ngan gyi stobs ma khyag ste bdag dpal chen po'i thugs ka nas mtshon cha'i char phab pas/ dug lnga ru tra'i phung po la 'dam brtsigs kyi phung por sgyog phog pa ltar khrol gyis zhig pa las khog pa dur khrod kyi zhing khams chen por gyur/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ ye shes kyi me rlung chus gtor ma'i dngos 'dzin nyes skyon thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod dbang gi gzhal yas khang chen por gtor ma dpal chen po'i lha tshogs/ gtor rgyu 'dod yon lnga yi mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pas dkyil 'khor gyi bar mtshams thams cad gang bar gyur/ e maṇ+ḍa la/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ oṃ pad+ma ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: nang bcud kyi sems can dbang chen rol pa'i lha tshogs su gyur/ bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams la phog /de dag rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyi rol du khro bo dang mtshon cha'i gur khang phub pas bdag cag 'khor bcas srung zhing skyob par mdzad/

pho nya thams cad las la bskul/ dgra bgegs bkug cing mtshon cha'i char phab nas bsgral/ sha khrag lhag ma med par gsol/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs 'gyed pas byad phur chag chen thams cad bzlog par bsam/ drag sngags chig dril 'di bzla/ hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta di ma da ri h+ya grī ba e ka dzā ṭi ru lu ru lu hrīḥdza dzaḥ.e dzaḥbh+yo ma ma rak+ṣa: nṛ tri dzaḥrbad: a phṛ sarba bh+yo zlog: ces bzla/ snod bcud lhar gsal ba rnams rngams pa'i sgra sgrog cing las la chas par bsam/ gtor mar sman raka bsgreng*/ hūm̐: dmar nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: dbang gi rgyal po dpal chen rta skad bzhad: yum mchog e ka dzā ṭi sras mchog gnyis: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las rab bzhi: dbyings phyug bzhi dang zhi khro ma mo khyung: pho rgyud mo rgyud gza' klu zil gnon brgyad: yum chen brgyad dang dbang gi sgo ma bzhi: sku sprul dung gi dred mo mgo gsum ma: gsung sprul zangs kyi 'phar ba mgo brgyad ma: thugs sprul lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu ma: yon tan g.yu yi spyang mo mgo gsum ma: phrin las gser gyi seṅge rngams pa mo: gnyis med dung gi seṅge mgo bcu ma: dung gi rgyab 'brel lcags kyu dgra s+t+wa thogs: ral gseb gza' rgod mig dmar char 'beb 'brug la 'chib: gser gyi rgyab 'brel lcags kyi khyung chen thogs: ral gseb nyi ma 'bum 'phro lcags sdig 'chib: zangs kyi rgyab 'brel sbrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin: dug dang me yi char 'beb ba glang 'chib: g.yu yi rgyab 'brel zhing gi dbyug pa 'phyar: gri mtshon char 'beb dred mo kham pa 'chib: dung gser zangs g.yu byi ru mchong bse shel: dpal gyi khyi brgyad nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog: mig ni nyi ltar spu gri'i mche ba gtsigs: de bzhin dpal gyi spyang brgyad ral pa can: dur khrod gzigs shing kha nas ro bshal ba: dkar mo zla 'dab ser mo nyi 'dab ma:

dmar mo me 'dab sngon mo chu 'dab bzhi: mig nas me 'bar sna nas bu yug 'tshubs: kha nas chu 'khrug mche bas khams gsum sgrol: rlung 'brug mthing ga rlung gi gshog pa can: me 'brug dmar po me yi gshog pa can: chu 'brug sngon po sbrul gyi gshog pa can: sna tshogs gzugs 'chang rdo rje'i gshog pa can: kun kyang mkha' la 'gro zhing 'brug sgra sgrog: sprul pa yang sprul bsam mi khyab par bcas: pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs thugs dam can: mi mngon dbyings nas skur bzhengs 'dir gshegs la: dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'di la brtan par bzhugs: gnyis med gus pas phyag bgyi bzhes su gsol: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: thugs dam rgyud bskul bstod do phrin las mdzod: dbang dang byin rlabs mthu nus bstsal du gsol: thugs dam thugs rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol: ces bskul gser skyems raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gser skyems ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang: mdo sgyu sems gsum sgrub sde chen po brgyad: khyad par pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ma mgon lcam dral pad+ma'i bka' srung tshogs: dregs chen sum cu sngags bdag bco brgyad dang: phyi nang gsang ba'i gab sbas sde brgyad rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs dang brgyud kyi srung: yul ris gnas kyi lha srung dkor gyi bdag: lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba rnams: gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed: ces pas gser skyems 'bul zhing dpang gzug pa ni/ hūm̐: dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro dam can ma lus dgongs su gsol: gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa la: mi phyed dad pas zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor bdag:

sgrub pa snying po dam du bcas pa la: bar chad 'tshe ba dgra dang bgegs kyis byas: da ni mngon spyod drag po'i las brtsam pas: lha dang dam can rgya mtsho grogs la byon: bdag ni ma nyes dam nyams dgra bo nyes: nyes byas 'di la chad pa mi gcod cing: nyes med rnal 'byor bdag gi grogs g.yel na: sngon gyi thugs dam gnyan po mi 'gal lam: da ni gzu dang dpang mdzod grogs la byon: ma g.yel ma g.yel rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: bka' srung dam can thams cad las la chos: ling ga dgra bgegs su gsal ba ni/ mdun du e las brub khung gru gsum pa'i nang du dgra bgegs rnams nyam thag pa'i lus can du gyur/ bden stobs brjod cing 'gugs gzhug ni/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang/ khyad par pad+ma dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sprul pa yang sprul bka' sdod srung ma dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gis bsdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzugs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra dang*/ gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khongs gar gnas gar bros kyang*/ skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig /oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: nṛ tri badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes ci mang bya/ de nas pho nya bskul zhing phyag rgyas btab pa gzugs dbab mthu 'phrog byad bcug smyor gzhug rnams kyi/

dang po bskul zhing dmod pa ni/ hūm̐ dza: dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs: sprul pa chen po'i dus la babs: dbang chen rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams: drag po'i phrin las dus la babs: pho nya las mkhan mthu rtsal can: gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes: yid la brnags pa'i dgra bo rnams: dbang du sdus la 'dir khug cig: snying rje'i pho nya dkar mo'i tshogs: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zungs: byams pa'i pho nya ser mo'i tshogs: zhags pa can gyis rke nas chings: dga' ba'i pho nya dmar mo'i tshogs: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: btang snyoms pho nya ljang mo'i tshogs: dril bu can gyis myos su chugs: badz+ra aṅku sha dza: badz+ra pā sha hūm̐: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: hūm̐: dbang chen sprul pa'i pho nya rnams: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la babs: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can gyi: rnam shes lus rten 'di la phob: dbang dang dam tshig la sogs pa'i: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul med par gyis: las kyi zhags pa 'bar ba yis: dgra bgegs dam nyams byad du chugs: dmar chen rak+ta 'bar ba yis: dam nyams dgra bgegs myos su chugs: zhes phyag rgya bzhi yungs dkar/ thang phrom/ nad khrag smyo khrag rnams bdug cing*/ so so'i rgya bcas/ oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: dgra bgegs ā be sha ya ā be sha ya: a pa na ya a pa na ya: shrī gh+raṃ ā na ya: dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya: hūm̐ phaṭa: dmigs pa rnams yang yang bya/ gu gul bdug cing bya 'ug gi sgros byab/ hūm̐: dbang chen khro rgyal 'bar ba'i bka' la nyon: dgra bgegs skyob byed lha srung gzhan du dengs: gal te mi nyan 'di yi skyabs byed rnams: ye shes lha ni thugs dam nyams par 'gyur: 'jig rten lha ni rdul du brlag par byed: de bas 'di yi mgon skyabs ma mdzad cig: dgra bgegs skyob byed kyi lha srung mā ra ya phaṭa: ces lha dang dbye/ de nas gsal ba gsum ldan gyis/ hūm̐:

bdag nyid dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka: che btsan 'gran bral snang srid g.yo zhing 'khrugs: thugs la ye shes 'bar ba'i srog kyang zhugs: phyag gnyis nyi zla'i bar du hūm̐ yig las: 'od 'phros rgyal mchod sems can sgrib pa sbyangs: mthu stobs kun 'dus pad+ma kī la ya: zhal gsum phyag drug sku smad phur pa'i dbal: sku gsung thugs ldan mthu rtsal bsam mi khyab: dgra bgegs snying nang dwangs ma lnga la btab: rags pa nyi shu phra ba lnga rnams bcom: tshe bsod nṛ yig dpal rnams bdag la 'dus: rnam shes sgrib sbyangs rgyal ba'i thugs kar thim: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī ba kī li kī la ya nṛ tri mā ra ya phaṭa: puṇ+ye saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ ā: s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: rdzong 'phrang srog ldan khrus kyi dgongs pa bskyangs la/ bsreg cing mnan pa ni brten pa dbyings su bsgral ba'o// rten gzhi bag chags sbyong ba ni/ khro bo dang dregs pa rnams kyis mtshon cha dang thun gyi char phab nas dgra bgegs rdul du brlag par bsam/ hūm̐: phur thun khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs: yungs dkar lha yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs: khram thun gshin rje'i tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs: dug thun klu yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs: rdo thun gnod sbyin tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs: khrag thun ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs: rtsang thun btsan gyi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs: mtshe thun the'u rang tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs: mdung thun bdud kyi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs: dgra s+t+wa ging gi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs: mda' thun gza' yi tshogs rnams kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs:

hūm̐: dbang gi sprul pa'i shan pa 'bum: spu gri rlung gi 'dab gshog can: sgrol byed mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis: dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlogs: dgra bgegs mā ra ya nṛ tri sha trūṃ: hūm̐: khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du: khro bo'i 'bar ba'i rdo rjes brdung: lha 'am 'on te bdud kyang rung: thal ba'i rdul du brlag par bya: dgra bgegs kha thaṃ kha thaṃ: sha khrag bdud rtsir bsam nas/ hūm̐: dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dug gsum dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus: sku gsum ye shes klong du bzhes nas kyang: khams gsum 'khor ba 'od gsal dbyings su sgrol: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi: zhes zhal du bstab/ dmar chen sbreng ba ni/ rak+ta sbreng zhing*/ hūm̐: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: zhe sdang khrag gi rgya mtsho chi li li: dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la: zhe sdang khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: gti mug khrag gi rgya mtsho chi li li: dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la: gti mug khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: nga rgyal khrag gi rgya mtsho chi li li: dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la: nga rgyal khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho chi li li: dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la: 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: phrag dog khrag gi rgya mtsho chi li li: dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs 'dir gshegs la: phrag dog khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di la rol: khro bo rol pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: bar chad bdud rnams bsgral pa'i khrag mtsho 'khyil: dpal chen dbang chen lha tshogs 'dir gshegs shig: bar chad bdud rnams bsgral pa'i khrag la rol:

dpal chen khrag 'thung lha tshogs mkha' dang mnyam: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs: mkha' dbyings pad+ma'i rak+ta sha ra ra: dmar chen khrag gi sbreng mo chi li li: hūm̐: he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs te: dur khrod chen po'i gnas 'di ru: zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas: dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ rgya mtshor 'khyil: mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas kyis: ma lus bzhes shing bsnam du gsol: dang po sbreng bas/ rak+ta'i dwangs ma bdud rtsi'i ngo bor sum cha gsol bar bsam/ hūm̐: nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste: 'khor ba'i dra bas chags pa yi: dmar chen bskyil ba'i rgya mtsho skyil: 'khor ba'i mkha' 'gro rnams dang rol: ma rungs 'dod la rab chags shing: dam tshig la sdang dgra chen rnams: thugs rje byang sems ldan pa yi: ngo mthon stobs kyis bsgral bar gyur: gnyis sbreng bas/ rak+ta dgra bgegs kyi ngo bor sum gnyis rol par gyur/ hūm̐: nga ni za byed chen po ste: khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang: gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir: sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya'o: gsum sbreng bas/ rak+ta'i snyigs ma zhing bcu'i dug gsum/ bar chad chag chen gyi ngo bor lhag med du gsol bar gyur/

gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings mnyam pa chen po'i gtor gzhong du: rig pa ye shes dpal gyi gtor chen bshams: dbyings rig gnyis su med pa'i gtor ma 'di: dpal chen rta mgrin dbang chen tshogs la 'bul: rtsol bcas bag nyal ngan rtog zlog tu gsol: skye med yum gyi mkha' dbyings gtor gzhong du: 'gag med bde ba thig le'i gtor ma bshams: bde stong gnyis su med pa'i gtor ma 'di: dpal chen rta mgrin dbang chen tshogs la 'bul: gnyis snang 'dzin pa'i bag chags zlog tu gsol: 'byung lnga dag pa phung po'i gtor gzhong du: dkar dmar byang chub sems kyi gtor ma bshams: phung khams lha ru dag pa'i gtor ma 'di: dpal chen rta mgrin dbang chen tshogs la 'bul: 'dzin pa'i sems kyi 'khrul rtog dbyings su zlog: phyi snod gzhal yas khang gi gtor gzhong du: nang bcud lha dang lha mo'i gtor ma bshams: snod bcud ye rdzogs chen po'i gtor ma 'di: dpal chen rta mgrin dbang chen tshogs la 'bul: gzung ba'i 'khrul snang ngan rtog zlog tu gsol: dur khrod 'jigs pa'i gzhal yas mdzes pa 'dir: bhan+dha lcang lo 'bru bcud gtor mas bkang: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bshams pa 'di: dpal chen rta mgrin rol pa'i tshogs la 'bul: chag chen nyam nga thams cad zlog tu gsol: ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: zlog pa'i phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang yi dam lha tshogs dang: dam can bka' srung thams cad rtsal ma zhan: mthu stobs dpung skyed phyi nang gsang ba yi: bar chad chag chen thams cad phyir zlog cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: hūm̐: dmar nag gru gsum dbang gi dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen khro rgyal rta mgrin rta skad bzhad: khams gsum dbang sdud srid gsum zil gyis gnon: khro bo khro mo rnams kyi dbus na 'gying: mkha' dbyings bde chen klong du 'khyil pa'i yum: e ka dzā ṭi pad+ma gzi ldan ma:

dgra bgegs 'di yi gzugs phung sems la rol: gti mug bdud kyi bar chad dgra la zlog: thabs mchog bde chen rol pa'i sras mchog dang: shes rab stong nyid yum las lcam gcig ma: dgra bgegs 'di yi chags sdang gnyis la rol: bsam sbyor ngan dang sdang sems dgra la zlog: me long ye shes rdo rje rta skad bzhad: rig stong dbyer med rdo rje dbyings phyug ma: dgra bgegs 'di yi rnam shes khrag la rol: zhe sdang bdud kyi bar chad dgra la zlog: mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen rta skad bzhad: snang stong dbyer med rin chen dbyings phyug ma: dgra bgegs 'di yi tshor ba sha la rol: nga rgyal bdud kyi bar chad dgra la zlog: sor rtog ye shes pad+ma rta skad bzhad: bde stong dbyer med pad+ma dbyings phyug ma: dgra bgegs 'di yi 'du shes khrag la rol: 'dod chags bdud kyi bar chad dgra la zlog: bya grub ye shes las rab rta skad bzhad: tshor stong dbyer med las rab dbyings phyug ma: dgra bgegs 'di yi 'du byed dbugs la rol: phrag dog bdud kyi bar chad dgra la zlog: hūm̐ bh+yo: dag pa'i snang ba ye shes zil gnon rgyal: snang stong dbyer med khro mo mi pham ma: dgra bgegs mig gi rnam shes yul la rol: ma dag 'khrul snang ltas ngan dgra la zlog: rang byung gsung gdang khro bo zil gnon rgyal: grags stong dbyer med khro mo khro gnyer ma: dgra bgegs rna ba'i rnam shes yul la rol: sgra ru 'khrul pa'i ltas ngan dgra la zlog: ye shes rlung lnga ma mo zil gnon rgyal: rlung sems dbyer med lha mo ro langs ma: dgra bgegs sna yi rnam shes yul la rol: tshogs drug 'khrul pa'i nad yams dgra la zlog: khams drug dag pa'i bya khyung zil gnon rgyal: rtsa thig sems gsum dbyer med spyan gcig ma: dgra bgegs lce yi rnam shes yul la rol: myang ba rang 'khrul mug yams dgra la zlog: 'od lus ye shes pho rgyud zil gnon rgyal:

dngos med dngos 'dra rdo rje las byed ma: dgra bgegs lus kyi rnam shes yul la rol: lus kyi bdag 'dzin mtshon 'khrugs dgra la zlog: rig pa rang gsal mo rgyud zil gnon rgyal: gang shar rang grol gshin rje las byed ma: dgra bgegs yid kyi rnam shes yul la rol: 'dzin rtog ngan pa'i bar chad dgra la zlog: rang snang 'od gsal klu rnams zil gnon rgyal: stong pa zang thal klu mo las byed ma: dgra bgegs nyon yid rnam shes yul la rol: nyon mongs g.yo 'khrugs bar chad dgra la zlog: ka nas dag pa gza' rnams zil gnon rgyal: gdod nas lhun grub gnod sbyin las byed ma: dgra bgegs kun gzhi'i rnam shes yul la rol: ma rig sgrib g.yogs bar chad dgra la zlog: hūm̐ bh+yo: stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug lcags kyu ma: dgra bgegs chad par lta ba 'di la rol: 'chi bdag bdud kyi bar chad dgra la zlog: byams pa byang chub sems kyi zhags pa ma: dgra bgegs rtag par lta ba 'di la rol: phung po bdud kyi bar chad dgra la zlog: dga' ba bde stong dbyer med lcags sgrog ma: dgra bgegs bdag tu lta ba 'di la rol: nyon mongs bdud kyi bar chad dgra la zlog: btang snyoms shes rab chen po'i dril bu ma: dgra bgegs mtshan mar lta ba 'di la rol: lha bu'i bdud kyi bar chad dgra la zlog: sku yi ye shes dred mo mgo gsum rngams: gsung gi ye shes 'phar ba dbu brgyad zug: thugs kyi ye shes spyang mo mgo dgukhros: yon tan ye shes g.yu spyang mgo gsum ma: phrin las ye shes gser gyi seng ge 'gying: gnyis med ye shes seng ge mgo bcu ma: sprul pa'i ma mo kham rgya ma drug ni: dam nyams dgra yi khams chen drug la rol: 'gro drug 'khrul pa'i sdug bsngal dgra la zlog: dpal gyi bka' sdod long ba rgyab 'brel bzhi: pho nya 'jigs pa'i khyi brgyad phyogs bcur rgyug: za byed spyang mo brgyad ni ngu zug byed:

las byed 'dab chen bzhi ni nam mkhar 'phur: 'brug mo ngur mo bzhi ni mkha' la 'phyo: dregs pa sde bcu'i dmag tshogs rlung ltar 'tshubs: dbyings las ye shes rol pa bsam mi khyab: sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis: dgra bgegs dam nyams las ngan bsgral pa yi: zag khams so gnyis sha khrag rus par bcas: lhag ma med pa da lta nyid du bzhes: bar chad chag chen thams cad dgra la zlog: hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta di ma da ri h+ya grī ba e ka dzā ṭi ru lu ru lu hrīḥdzaḥdza: e dzaḥbh+yo: ma ma rak+ṣa: nṛ tri dzaḥrbad: a phri sarba bh+yo zlog: lhag ma btang la rtsang zlog pho nya bskul pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal po yi: drag po dpal gyi gtor chen gyi: gdug pa'i lcags ri nag po la: dmar nag rtsang phur srin mo 'gros: las mkhan pho nya'i rten du btsugs: yar gyi rtse mos srid rtser snyegs: mar gyi rtse mos dmyal khams gzir: sked pa gzhal yas stong gsum tsam: dur khrod drag po'i mchod sprin gtibs: las mkhan tshogs rnams 'dir bzhugs la: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bzhes: phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad du gsol: hūm̐: dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal po yis: 'jig rten khams rnams ma lus pa'i: nyon mongs dgra bgegs zhi bar mdzod: zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med: dngul lam dkar po'i shing rnams la: zhi ba'i rtsang phur zlum po ris: yar gyi rtse la dud sprin 'khrigs: mar gyirtse la me chen 'bar: sked pa rgya mdud gzhal yas khang: he ru ka yi skur gyur nas: zhi mdzad sprul pa bsam mi khyab: nad yams 'khrugs rtsod thams cad kun: da lta nyid du zhi bar mdzod: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī ba nad mug 'khrugs rtsod thams cad zhi bar gyur cig shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: hūm̐: dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal po yis: 'jig rten khams rnams ma lus pa'i: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod: rgyas par ma gyur gang yang med: gser ram ser po'i shing rnams la:

rgyas pa'i rtsang phur gru bzhi pa: yar gyi rtse la lho sprin gtibs: mar gyi rtse la rgya mtsho 'khrugs: sked pa rgya mdud gzhal yas khang: he ru ka yi skur gyur nas: rgyas mdzad sprul pa bsam mi khyab: tshe dang bsod nams ma lus pa: da lta nyid du rgyas par mdzod: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta rat+na kro dha h+ya grī ba tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par gyur cig puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hāḥ hūm̐: dbang chen rta mgrin rgyal po yis: 'jig rten khams rnams ma lus pa'i: rgyal blon 'bangs nor pho mo 'bru: dbang du ma 'dus gang yang med: zangs sam dmar po'i shing rnams la: dbang gi rtsang phur zla gam dbyibs: yar gyi rtse la 'od dmar 'khrugs: mar gyi rtse la pho nya 'phro: sked pa rgya mdud gzhal yas khang: he ru ka yi skur gyur nas: dbang mdzad sprul pa bsam mi khyab: rgyal blon 'bangs nor pho mo 'bru: skad cig nyid la dbang du sdus: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta pad+ma kro dha h+ya grī ba rgyal blon rje 'bangs pho mo 'bru nor wa shaṃ ku ru swā hā: hūm̐: dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal po yis: 'jig rten khams ni ma lus kun: dgra bgegs log 'dren dam sri rnams: brlag par ma mdzad gang yang med: lcags sam drag po'i shing rnams la: drag po'i rtsang phur zur gsum pa: yar gyi rtse la dug rlangs 'phro: mar gyi rtse la mtshon cha 'khrugs: sked pa rgya mdud gzhal yas khang: he ru ka yi skur gyur nas: brlag mdzad sprul pa bsam mi khyab: dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad kun: skad cig nyid la brlag par mdzod: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta karma kro dha h+ya grī ba dgra bgegs log 'dren dam sri thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐: 'dul byed drag po'i rtsang phur gyi: yar gyi rtse la khyung chen lding: khyung ru gnam du zangs se zang: mar gyi rtse la chu srin 'phyo: ral pa nag po sprin ltar gtibs: sked par dung gi seng ge 'gying: g.yu yi ral pa nyi li li: yar gyi rtse la rgya stag 'phyo:

stag mo 'dzum mdangs shig se shig: mar gyi rtse la gzig chen ngar: gzig chen ngar sgra 'u ru ru: sked par dom nag smyon pa rgyug: dom nag ngar sgra khra la la: yar gyi rtse la bya glag 'jum: bya glag 'jum mdangs shigs se shig: mar gyi rtse la bya rog grags: bya rog 'gyed sgra chems se chem: sked par gser gyi 'ug pa grags: 'ug pas hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: las mkhan tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs: dgra bgegs byad ma'i sha la rol: dpal gyi gtor chen lcags ri la: btsug pas dgra bgegs brlag par mdzod: byad ma gsod pa'i mtshon char brdung: chos skyong pho nya'i rten du 'dzug: bar chad sol la rkyen rnams zlog: sod cig dgra bgegs byad ma sod: zlog cig byad ma'i dmag dpung zlog: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gyer zhing*/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bya khyung rgyal po spyan drangs shing dpal chen po'i dbu brgyan par gyur/ hūm̐ hūm̐: dbyings nas ye shes chen po'i rol pa las: dpal chen bya khyung rgyal po ga ru ṭa: 'og min chos kyi dbyings nas 'dir gshegs la: ye shes dkyil 'khor 'di la brtan par bzhugs: sku gsung thugs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing: phyi nang gsang ba sbyor sgrol mchod pa 'bul: ral pa bsigs pas nam mkha'i dbyings su khengs: dbang chen rigs bzhi sprul pa 'bum 'bum 'phro: gnam lcags rwa rtses srid pa gsum rnams bcom: phra men mang po pho nya rlung ltar 'tshubs: gshog pa g.yas pas tshangs pa'i gnas rnams gtor: zil gnon yab brgyad khro bo'i thog ser 'beb: gshog pa g.yon gyis rgya mtsho phyags mas 'debs: zil gnon yum brgyad khro mo 'bum 'bum 'gyed: krang kring sgra sgrog ma mo dbang du sdud: zhal du klu gsol rgya mtsho gting nas 'dren: gnam lcags mchu 'gugs sde brgyad snying nas 'dren: mjug ma g.yu yi ral gri bsam chod 'bar:

dbang gi bka' srung thams cad las la 'gyed: spyan mig khrag mtsho khol zhing nyi ltar 'bar: srid gsum gang yin thams cad tha ler gzigs: sku la 'khor 'das kun rdzogs mkha' dbyings khyab: brjod med gsung gdangs chos kyi sprin sgra sgrog: mnyam nyid thugs mnga' 'bar ba'i gtum drag can: khyod kyis mi 'dul 'khor 'das gang yang med: ltas ngan cho 'phrul thams cad bzlog tu gsol: ye shes kyi khyung gi sku las las kyi khyung zhig 'phros pas ltas ngan rnams bsdus shing rnga mo la thim par bsam/ hūm̐: 'jigs pa'i pho nya ltas ngan kun tshang ba: skul byed rnga mo stobs ldan rdzu 'phrul can: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig dgra la zlog: dpral bar skyes bu zhubs can dmag tshogs 'khrigs: g.yul 'khrugs mtshon cha 'beb pa dgra la zlog: dpung g.yas sngags nag drag sngags bzla ba dgu: sngags pas phur zor 'phen pa dgra la zlog: dpung g.yon dge slong mdo sgrub byed pa dgu: ser chags rnams kyis 'bum bskor dgra la zlog: dpyi g.yas byis pa 'ur rdo thogs pa dgu: byis pa'i chung sri lang ba dgra la zlog: dpyi g.yon bud med dul mo rdeb pa dgu: yugs sa rnams kyis dmod mo dgra la zlog: rtsibs logs g.yas na bon po dzo zor dgu: bon po'i dzo dmar 'phen pa dgra la zlog: rtsibs logs g.yon na ngar glud dkar dmar dgu: lha 'dre'i za kha zug pa dgra la zlog: de steng las kyi khyung chen 'jigs rung bas: srid pa gsum gyi ltas ngan dgra la zlog: drag sngags thun gyis brab cing khang khyim mi mthong ba'i sar bskyal/ de nas slar yang zlog sgyur ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: dbang chen drag po'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mthu rtsal dpung skyed thugs dam dus la babs: chag che nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dgra la zlog: gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dgra la zlog:

dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad dgra la zlog: zlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog: sgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig dgra la zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu dgra la zlog: glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig dgra la zlog: zlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog: sgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: mo rtsis rmi lam ngan pa dgra la zlog: kag dang spar kha rtsub pa dgra la zlog: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dgra la zlog: zlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog: sgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: gzugs can mi yi byad kha dgra la zlog: gzugs med lha 'dre'i byad kha dgra la zlog: ban bon sngags pa'i byad kha dgra la zlog: zlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog: sgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: rje yi bka' chad 'beb pa dgra la zlog: 'bangs kyi kha mchu byed pa dgra la zlog: khyim mtshes nye ba'i nang 'khrugs dgra la zlog: zlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog: sgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: nad yams 'khrugs rtsod skal ngan dgra la zlog: btsa' sad ser gsum god kha dgra la zlog: chag chen nyam nga thams cad dgra la zlog: zlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis zlog: sgyur ro lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul dgra la sgyur: sa ma ya bh+yo zlog:

gsum pa las kyi mtha' bsdu ba ni/ sgrub zhag rdzogs pa'i nyin tha ma la khang steng du bsang dang gser skyems gtang*/ slob dpon chas su zhugs la/ hrīḥbh+yo dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ bh+yo hrīḥbh+yo bh+yo bh+yo phaṭa dza: gtor ma'i ye shes pa rang la thim/ dam tshig pa rnams dmag tshogs las la rngams par gyur/ sgo dbye ni/ hūm̐: shar gyi sgo ma lcags kyu ma: snying rje 'gyur med sgo phyes shig: lho yi sgo ma zhags pa ma: byams pa byang chub sgo phyes shig: nub kyi sgo ma lcags sgrog ma: dga' ba bde chen sgo phyes shig: byang gi sgo ma dril bu ma: btang snyoms tshad med sgo phyes shig: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: pra be sha ya phaṭa: thugs dam drag tu bskul ba ni/ gtor ma la sman raka bran/ hūm̐: dbang chen rol pa'i dur khrod che: 'jigs su rung ba'i pho brang nas: khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal: yum mchog e ka dzā ṭi ma: dbang gi phra men chen po gnyis: zil gnon khro rgyal yab yum tshogs: sgo ma bka' sdod srung mar bcas: drag po'i las la sku bzhengs shig: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: da ni khro bo'i dmag tshogs rnams: dgra bgegs steng du jag par chos: gza' bdud chas pa'i cho 'dra zhing: ye shes me dpung 'u ru ru: hūm̐ gi 'brug sgra di ri ri: dpal gyi ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: mtshon cha'i ser ba sha ra ra: khro rgyal tshogs rnams gshegs lam du: bdag gi dgra bo sgrol bar mdzod: g.yul ngo chen po'i yo lang gis: bdud kyi sde rnams phung bar gyis: gtor ma phyir spags chad mdo bsgrag / oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha h+ya grī ba hūm̐ phaṭa: zhes dzap dbyangs bya zhing srung ma skul pa ni/ hūm̐: dbang gi bka' srung khyed rnams kyis: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di'i: ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa rnams: g.yo sgyu med par gus ldan pa'i: sems kyis blangs te spyi bo yi: gtsug tu bkur bar bya 'o zhes: de skad khyod kyis bro bor ltar:

drag po'i las kyi grogs la byon: hrīḥpad+mān+ta kṛta di ma da ri h+ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hrīḥdzaḥdza: nṛ dzaḥ.a phri sarba bh+yo zlog: oṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma sarba tsit+ta ma bh+yo: oṃ shwa re kha hi bh+yo: oṃ tipa ta tsakra shwa na mu kha kha kha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ku ku rā dza rak+sha rak+ta khug: ti ta long ka hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa: hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa: trāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: haṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ dzag long to tse ri: yak+sha kun ban dza hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+re shwa rī siṃ ha hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ rat+ne shwa rī= pad+me shwa rī= karme shwa rī= dgra bgegs bh+yo zlog: dmag tshogs 'ur dir gyis chas par bsam la thebs dang bstun pa'i gang du 'phen pa'i sar phyin nas/ grogs bcol pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe dpal chen rta mgrin gyis: thar pa nag po btul pa'i tshe: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: bdud sde 'dul ba'i grogs mdzod cig: bar du klu sgrub yab sras kyis: mu stegs nag po tshar bcad tshe: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyen lam ci: bdud sde 'dul ba'i grogs mdzod cig: tha ma pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: bod kyi lha srin btul pa'i tshe: ji ltar rtags bstan bsnyel lam ci: bdud sde 'dul ba'i grogs mdzod cig: gong bzhin gser skyems 'bul zhing dpang gzug /dgug gzhug bya zhing dmigs pa'i 'ben gzug/ hūm̐: phur thun khro bo'i tshogs rnams kyis: sogs nas mda' thun bar/ drag sngags bzla zhing zor rnams 'phang*/ 1$0000250dam tshig pa'i lha rnams rang la thim zhing slar yang gtor ma dug mtshon du gyur pas dgra bo thal bar brlags par 1$0000300 bsam/ hūm̐: drag po zor gyi dpung tshogs rnams: sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs: thams cad thal ba rdul du rlogs: chag chen bar chad zlog tu gsol: drag sngags bzla zhing gtor rtse khyung gdong dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ dgra bgegs rjes med du song bar bsams la phyi mig mi blta bar srung 'khor sgom zhing tshur log

/sgo drung du dengs shing brtan skyong bro brdung bkra shis bya/ de nas tshe 'gugs sogs phrin las mjug bsdu ba'o// zhes pa 'di ni dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling du dbang chen rta mgrin gyi sgrub chen 'dzug pa'i skabs mchog gyur gling pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dbang ldan gyis bgyis pa'o// dge ba 'di yis 'gro kun sa lam gyi bar chad thams cad las grol te dbang chen rol pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //
